name: rinkside-analyst-agent
goal: Agent reads saved season data, finds non-obvious facts per team, publishes them as insight cards on the poster. Every number comes from a rerunnable query. Human approves each card before it ships.
nonGoals: Live chat on the public site (v1)

boxscores.notes: No goal events, no period data.

rules: Any claim touching box-score views must include coverage (archived vs finals) or it fails verification.
Claims needing period or event data are out of scope. Agent must decline, not estimate.

packageLayout.packages/analyst/src/views.sql: DuckDB views over data/. Hand-written, single source of truth for derived tables.
packageLayout.packages/analyst/src/sandbox.ts: Create sandbox, copy data/ read-only, install duckdb + jq, load views.
packageLayout.packages/analyst/src/schema.ts: InsightCard, EvidenceQuery (Effect Schema, shared with packages/season)
packageLayout.packages/analyst/src/rank.ts: LLM judge: novelty vs poster, triviality, dedupe

runtime.llm: Vercel AI SDK generateText with tools and stopWhen step cap, wrapped in an Effect service
runtime.execution: Vercel Sandbox, data/ copied read-only, duckdb + jq preinstalled, views loaded at startup, snapshot the prepared sandbox for fast cold starts
runtime.localDev: Same sandbox via SDK. No host filesystem access.

views.name: team_games
views.grain: one row per team per game

errorPolicy.onExceed: End run for that team, log failure

InsightCard.headline: template string, e.g. '{wins}-{losses} in one-goal games'

evidence.coverage: optional { archived: number, finals: number }, required if query touches skater_games or goalie_games

InsightCard.assert: optional SQL returning one boolean that must stay true
InsightCard.review: optional { by: 'ben', at: string, reason?: RejectReason }

keyRule: Model never writes numbers as text. Headline and body are templates filled from evidence.result via bindings. A literal digit outside a placeholder fails verification.

checks: rerun query in fresh sandbox, deep-equal result

writePending.rule: Never overwrite approved or rejected cards

review.v1: Workflow opens PR 'insights: <date>'. Approve by flipping status in diff or via CLI.
review.cli: bun run insights:review (render card + query, prompt a/r/e, record RejectReason)

stalenessRecheck.ifResultChangedAndAssertHolds: re-render with new values, stay approved

web.rpc: Add approved insights to GetTeamData payload, validated with shared schema
web.sourceDrawer: Shows query, result table, linked games. Each game opens existing Box score drawer (GetGameBoxscore).

evals.cadence: On prompt, tool, or view changes. Not nightly.

suites.name: qa_accuracy
suites.grading: numeric exact match, tolerance for percentages

categories.coverageTrap: Hughes points per game, must report archived-game coverage
categories.unanswerable: goals in the third period, must decline

suites.name: verify_pass_rate
suites.metric: share of generated cards passing verify, per prompt version

suites.name: human_approval_rate
suites.metric: from review fields; every 'wrong' rejection becomes a new QA case

suites.name: cost_latency
suites.metric: tokens, tool calls, wall time per team, from traces

contents: tool calls (input, truncated output, duration, error)

workflow.change: After data publish, run generate-insights and open PR

phases.exit: one real PR with pending cards for all 32 teams
approved cards live on rinkside.xyz and survive a refresh

openDecisions: Model for generate vs rank (cheaper rank model likely fine, measure with evals)
Backfill remaining box scores first (139/325 coverage)
Move review from PR diffs to authenticated /review page in P2
Data rights: confirm publishing derived stat claims against source terms (see docs/nhl-ingestion-framework-evaluation.md)

include: 1-2 concrete bugs caught (e.g. coverage omission, bound value drift after refresh)
